design_principle.name: QUOTA_CONSTRAINED_BALANCE_FEASIBILITY
donor_methods: matching as design before outcome analysis
cardinality/mixed-integer matching that targets balance constraints directly
entropy/stable balancing as evidence that balance should be an explicit optimization target rather than an incidental distance property
design_principle.adaptation: P22 is not an observational treatment-effect estimator. It borrows the design principle only: choose the experimental support using pre-outcome nuisance coordinates so the relation comparison is not driven by exposure imbalance.
design_principle.fixed_quota: 6 cells per side per material vertex; 96 core cells total
design_principle.primary_gate: pooled HEAVY_HEAVY vs MINOR_MINOR absolute selected-sample SMD <= 0.50 for every frozen feature

matcher.implementation: Rust std-only deterministic quota-preserving subset search
matcher.input: TSV exported from fresh P22 SHAM census only
matcher.initialization_rule: within each family x side stratum, rank candidates by deterministic FNV-1a hash(candidate_sha256 || start_index), choose six
matcher.move: one selected/unselected swap within the same family x side stratum
objective_lexicographic: minimize maximum absolute selected-sample SMD over nine frozen features
minimize maximum absolute log variance ratio
matcher.search: best-improvement coordinate descent to a local optimum for each deterministic start; retain the lexicographically best objective across starts
matcher.authorization: only if independent C++ and R recomputation both confirm the <=0.50 primary gate and all quotas/engagement constraints
matcher.failure: BALANCE_FEASIBILITY_HOLD; no selective arm is executed and no matcher parameter is changed inside P22

implementation_roles.JavaScript: preseal/receipt invariant verifier independent of Python

frozen_rivals.EXPOSURE_ONLY: If the relation boundary survives after the prospective balance gate, exposure-only is defeated within the declared balanced support; otherwise it is not defeated.
frozen_rivals.TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC: HEAVY_HEAVY QSEARCH-negative replication may remain specific to QSEARCH x SEARCH_TT among engines that instantiate that channel.
frozen_rivals.BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY: If Inanis QSEARCH x PAWN_EVAL_CACHE independently reproduces the predeclared HEAVY negative direction on carrier worlds while TT engines do likewise, the broader persistent-memory rival gains bounded support without asserting channel identity.
frozen_rivals.ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY: Persistent MINOR divergence after balanced support is evidence for engine-local semantic susceptibility within the tested architecture set.
frozen_rivals.RELATION_LABEL_ONLY: If HEAVY/MINOR labels fail to predict fresh response geometry after balance, the relation ontology is not promoted.

decision_tree: If fresh-world or SHAM census constitution fails: CONSTITUTION_HOLD.
If Rust matcher has no candidate satisfying the frozen gate or C++/R disagree: BALANCE_FEASIBILITY_HOLD; execute no selective arms.
If balanced selective experiment fails to replicate HEAVY CURVED/QSEARCH/negative across SF19/Berserk/Ethereal: P20_RELATION_BOUNDARY_NOT_FRESHLY_REPLICATED.
If HEAVY replicates and MINOR lacks a common fingerprint: EXPOSURE_BALANCED_RELATION_BOUNDARY_REPLICATED and EXPOSURE_ONLY defeated within scope.
Carrier/Inanis results then distinguish bounded TT-specific support from broader qsearch persistent-memory support; sign agreement never grants channel homology.
Any robust-WDL change is reported separately and does not retroactively alter the matching design.
authority_ceiling: No universal theorem from four engines.
No claim that TT and pawn-evaluation caches are the same causal variable.
No claim beyond the exact frozen world families, resources, source locks and intervention mappings.
A structural zero is a boundary of the abstraction map, not missing data to be imputed.
Failure to transport is scientifically admissible and must remain visible.
